record.frame: Pollen's mesh frame for upper_leg_rigidity_plate.stl — the same frame as upper_leg_left.stl (the MJCF places both with pos (0,0,-42.5) quat (0.5,-0.5,-0.5,-0.5) in body upper_leg_left, and mirrored in body upper_leg_right). X = plate thickness 42.5..43.5 (outer face at 42.5, the face toward the housing at 43.5), Y = width -12..33, Z = length -11..47.06. Servo axes A0 = (y 0, z 0) hip pitch and A1 = (y 22, z 35.777) knee.

interfaces.name: screw_1
interfaces.what: Ø2.2 through hole, M2 clearance, head on the outer face x 42.5. Coaxial (to 0.01 mm in y, z) with the thigh housing's pin_1 at x 64.5 on the far side of the knee XL330 — the screw goes through this plate into the servo's front M2 hole while the housing's pin locates its rear. Screw length and whether the XL330 front face is tapped there: CANNOT DETERMINE without a servo in hand.
interfaces.source: MEASURED off Pollen's mesh 2026-09-01: cecad.meshfeatures hole Ø2.2 at (43.0, -0.5, 43.777) length 1.0; meshslice x=43 loop y[-1.60..0.60] z[42.68..44.88]

interfaces.name: screw_2
interfaces.what: Ø2.2 through, coaxial with the housing's pin_2; with screw_1 the knee servo's pair (16.0 apart in z, 22.5 from the knee axis along -y).

interfaces.name: screw_3
interfaces.what: Ø2.2 through, coaxial with the housing's pin_3; with screw_4 the hip-pitch servo's pair (16.0 apart in y, 22.5 from the hip-pitch axis along +z).

interfaces.name: screw_4
interfaces.what: Ø2.2 through, coaxial with the housing's pin_4.
